name: Wildcards
author: GKartist75 (with PI Agent)
description: Dynamic wildcard expansion for prompts + named variables + templates + character profiles + usage stats, all audited by a built-in linter. Use __name__ syntax for random picks, __$var=value__ to set a variable manually, __$var:file__ for reusable captured variables. v1.7.0 adds an AI Wildcard Generator that invents new entries with Wan2GP's own local LLM (or offline), a collection-wide integrity auditor, and cross-platform lowercase paths.
